title: Crop Insurance Cover and the Lending Limit on Insurance-Required Operating Lines of Credit
content:
On an Operating Lines of Credit product whose crop insurance requirement applies, how much of the lending limit a member may advance against turns on the crop insurance cover assigned to the line.

## Rule

On a product with the crop insurance requirement, the lending limit is taken:

- **at 0.8 of itself** when the line has no active Crop Insurance policy for its crop year with the indemnity assigned to this line, or that policy's coverage level is below the product's minimum coverage level;
- **at 0.95 of itself** when it has such a policy at a coverage level of at least the product's minimum coverage level but below 80 percent;
- **at the whole of itself** in every other case.

On a product that is not revolving the lending limit taken is the commitment. The share multiplies the lending limit before the outstanding principal, or the advances already booked, are taken off it. The policy's status, crop year, assignment and coverage level are read from the Crop Insurance records.

## Figures by product

| Product | Crop insurance requirement | Minimum coverage level | No assigned policy, or below the minimum | Minimum up to but not including 80% | 80% or more |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| StartRight Operating Line | Applies | 70% | 0.8 | 0.95 | Whole |
| Seasonal Operating Loan | Applies | 70% | 0.8 | 0.95 | Whole |
| Borrowing Base Operating Line | Applies | 65% | 0.8 | 0.95 | Whole |
| ExpressLine Operating Credit | Does not apply | 0% | Whole | Whole | Whole |
| Revolving Operating Line | Does not apply | 0% | Whole | Whole | Whole |
| Agribusiness Revolving Line | Does not apply | 0% | Whole | Whole | Whole |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical Seasonal Operating Loan, commitment USD 400,000)

| Assigned crop-year policy, coverage | Share | Commitment taken |
|---|---|---|
| None | 0.8 | USD 320,000 |
| 65% (below the 70% minimum) | 0.8 | USD 320,000 |
| 70% | 0.95 | USD 380,000 |
| 79% | 0.95 | USD 380,000 |
| 80% | Whole | USD 400,000 |
